constraints: Preserve target width, fill-string behavior, string coercion, and handling of values already wider than the requested length.

steps.instructions: Delete left-pad from package metadata and refresh the lockfile.

findings.title: PyCrypto is obsolete and vulnerable
findings.summary: pycrypto is declared as >=2.6; resolved: not found in a supported lockfile. The archived project warns that PyCrypto 2.x is unmaintained, obsolete, and contains security vulnerabilities.

constraints: Treat this as a security-sensitive migration: preserve algorithms, modes, key sizes, padding, nonces or IVs, authentication tags, and serialized ciphertext formats.
Do not silently change cryptographic primitives or defaults without explicit compatibility and security review.

steps.title: Choose the maintained library
steps.instructions: Select pycryptodome for a closer Crypto namespace migration or cryptography for a higher-level maintained interface.

steps.title: Migrate cryptographic usages
steps.instructions: Update every reported import and operation, making keys, modes, padding, nonces, tags, and encoding explicit.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove pycrypto, add the selected maintained package, and regenerate the environment lock data.

steps.title: Verify cryptographic test vectors
steps.instructions: Confirm known plaintext/ciphertext vectors and backward compatibility with persisted encrypted data.

verification.purpose: Run cryptographic vectors and repository tests.
Check installed dependency compatibility.
